canonicalization.rule: Treat catalog records, series index entries, scans/mirrors and citations as manifestations of one scholarly-work identity unless provenance proves a distinct edition or revision.

rights_access.rule: Do not infer redistribution rights from cataloging, citation, indexing, or discoverability.

promotion.reason: Metadata-level identity verification is insufficient for proposition promotion; lawful text, exact passage, dependency and provenance checks remain required.
